description: Implementation of BreakpadController class managing crash reporting, configuration, and report uploads for iOS using Breakpad.

classes.name: BreakpadController
classes.description: Singleton class managing crash report collection, configuration, and upload for iOS using Breakpad.

methods.name: sharedInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of BreakpadController.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Disabled initializer, returns nil.

methods.name: initSingleton
methods.description: Initializes the singleton instance, sets up dispatch queue and default configuration.

methods.name: dealloc
methods.description: Cleans up resources; should not be called directly.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts crash reporting, optionally on current thread.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops crash reporting.

methods.name: threadUnsafeSendReportWithConfiguration:withBreakpadRef:
methods.description: Uploads crash report with given configuration.

methods.name: setUploadingEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables crash report uploads.

methods.name: updateConfiguration
methods.description: Updates crash reporting configuration.

methods.name: resetConfiguration
methods.description: Resets configuration to defaults.

methods.name: setUploadingURL
methods.description: Sets the URL to upload crash reports.

methods.name: setUploadInterval
methods.description: Sets the interval between crash report uploads.

methods.name: setParametersToAddAtUploadTime
methods.description: Sets additional parameters for upload.

methods.name: addUploadParameter:forKey:
methods.description: Adds a parameter to be included during upload.

methods.name: removeUploadParameterForKey:
methods.description: Removes a parameter from upload parameters.

methods.name: withBreakpadRef:
methods.description: Executes a callback with the current BreakpadRef.

methods.name: hasReportToUpload:
methods.description: Checks if there are crash reports to upload.

methods.name: getCrashReportCount:
methods.description: Retrieves the number of crash reports.

methods.name: getNextReportConfigurationOrSendDelay:
methods.description: Gets next report configuration or delay before sending.

methods.name: sendDelay
methods.description: Calculates delay before next crash report upload.

methods.name: reportWillBeSent
methods.description: Records timestamp of report being sent.

methods.name: sendStoredCrashReports
methods.description: Handles sending stored crash reports respecting delay intervals.
